source: Coordinates: OpenStreetMap Nominatim (existing area-knowledge snapshot plus fixes). Drive times and road distance: OSRM demo server (router.project-osrm.org) table service, free-flow car times on OpenStreetMap roads, the slower direction of the two. Markets: Trinidad municipal corporations grouped as Bops regions (Maraval, Moka, Fairways are Diego Martin Borough per Wikipedia/dmbc.gov.tt).

coordNotes.Long Circular: coords fixed: old point was in south Trinidad (10.34,-61.45); now Long Circular Road, St. James (Nominatim)
coordNotes.Bayshore: coords fixed: old point was a church in Marabella (south); OSM has no Bayshore (Diego Martin) point, so it takes Westmoorings
coordNotes.Fort George: added: Fort George, St. James hills (Nominatim)
coordNotes.St Joseph Village: added: St. Joseph Village, San Fernando (Nominatim)
coordNotes.Queen's Park Savannah: added: Queen's Park Savannah, Port of Spain (Nominatim)
